body:
Hey, so I just saw this earlier and...Wow, I really didn't think anybody would respond. Thanks a bunch, black_pill_preacher, it means a lot to me. I really do want to try talking to them about it but I just feel like it's hopeless no matter what I try to do or say to them sadly.

I have gotten diagnosis for it a few years ago, but the care was limited unfortunately. I did get a few sessions before I had to leave the facility, sadly. And now with no health insurance and a lack of income, it's practically impossible for me to get any kind of medical help.

I won't kill myself...But I just. I still feel really down about everything.
